name: waterbots-open-core-modules
description: Open core modules for WaterBots. Workspace root; nothing here is published.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @waterbots/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: node scripts/check-packages.mjs && node --test .github/lanes/lane-rule.test.mjs scripts/check-names.test.mjs scripts/check-paid-code.test.mjs scripts/check-seed.test.mjs scripts/check-engine-entry.test.mjs && node scripts/check-seed.mjs && node scripts/check-engine-entry.mjs && node scripts/check-paid-code.mjs packages && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build -w @waterbots/core && npm run build -w @waterbots/calvin -w @waterbots/phoebe -w @waterbots/bridget
